app.name: Tidyboards
app.summary: For people who keep little bits of personal info scattered around, Tidyboards gives them tidy personal dashboards. They create a dashboard, add note, counter, checklist, and link-list widgets, then configure, arrange, and resize them. Changes save automatically so the dashboard is ready on every visit.
app.audience: People who want a small personal dashboard for notes, counts, tasks, and links

roles.name: Visitor
roles.description: Person learning what Tidyboards is; can start sign up from the landing page but has no dashboards

roles.name: Member
roles.description: Owner of personal dashboards; creates and manages dashboards and all widgets inside them

vocabulary.description: Named container for widgets; has name and last-edited time, can be renamed, duplicated, deleted
Block inside a dashboard; has title, type (note, counter, checklist, linklist), size small/medium/large, position, and type-specific settings and content
Single row inside a checklist widget; has text and ticked or unticked state
Single row inside a link-list widget; has title and web address

capabilities.note: Email/password sign up, sign in, sign out for dashboard owners
Each user sees and edits only their own dashboards and widgets
Create, list, view, rename, duplicate, delete dashboards and widgets
Visitor for landing page plus signed-in member
Public landing page explaining dashboards and how to start
Change widget position relative to other widgets
Show last-edited time on dashboard list; no deadlines

inScope: Public landing page that says what personal dashboards are for and how to start
Sign up, sign in, sign out; each user sees only their own dashboards
Create, list with last-edited time, rename, duplicate, and delete dashboards
Editor that saves all dashboard and widget changes automatically
Add note, counter, checklist, and link-list widgets with a title and type-specific settings
Rename, reposition relative to other widgets, resize to small/medium/large, and remove widgets
Use widgets: edit note text; set counter label and increase/decrease value; add and tick checklist items; add titles/addresses and open links

assumptions.text: New dashboards start named 'Untitled dashboard' and can be renamed to any non-empty name.
Duplicating a dashboard copies its name as 'Copy of {name}' plus all widgets, settings, and content.
Deleting a dashboard permanently removes it and all its widgets, items, and links with no trash or undo.
Widgets live in a single ordered list per dashboard; reposition means move earlier/later in that order and visual placement is up to design.
New widgets default to medium size; size can only be small, medium, or large.
Counter widget has a label and an integer value starting at 0; plus/minus changes it by 1 with no minimum or maximum, negatives allowed.
Checklist widget holds items with non-empty text and ticked/unticked state; ticking toggles state, adding requires text.
Link-list entries require a title and a web address starting with http:// or https://; selecting a link opens it in a new tab.
Editor autosaves every create, edit, reorder, resize, and delete shortly after the change and updates the dashboard last-edited time.
Dashboards and their widgets are private to the user who created them; there is no sharing or collaboration.
